BPSC School Teacher TRE 4.0 Recruitment 2026

Post Date: August 18, 2026

5:15 pm

Bihar Public Service Commission (BPSC), has released a Notification for the recruitment of TRE 4.0 School Teachers on its official website. This recruitment is for 32,388 positions. The BPSC application process will start on 01 September 2026, and candidates can apply until 29 September 2026. The minimum age limit is 18 – 21 years, and the maximum age limit is 42 years as of 01 January 2026. Candidates must check the complete details for the BPSC School Teacher TRE 4.0 Recruitment 2026 provided below.

    • Debit Card

    • Internet Banking
    • IMPS
    • Cash Card / Mobile Wallet
BPSC School Teacher TRE 4.0 Notification 2026 : Age Limits As On 01 August 2025
  • Minimum Age : 18 Years (Class 1, to 05 & 6 to 8)
  • Minimum Age : 21 Years (Class 9 to 10 & 11 to 12)
  • Maximum Age : 37 Years (UR-Male)
  • Maximum Age : 40 Years (UR-Female)
  • Maximum Age : 40 Years (BC/ EBC-Male & Female)
  • Maximum Age : 42 Years (SC/ ST-Male & Female)
  • Bihar BPSC provides age relaxation for the Special School TRE 4.0 position as per their regulations.
